text:
deploy-bot: opening schema window for users.username uniqueness enforcement (mig-2025-10-07-username-uniq). Plan: create shadow partial UNIQUE INDEX ON lower(username) where active=true, run validation job, then CREATE CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID + VALIDATE CONSTRAINT. Canary traffic split: 0.5% -> 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Estimated ops 30-60m per region. Use /hold to stop.

DevLead: high level: we must avoid taking exclusive locks on users table. Use CONCURRENTLY / NOT VALID flow. Who's owning validation job?

June P: I will. Validator will run in batches and is idempotent. I have a script that finds duplicates and marks for remediation. It runs as low-priority and reports progress to this thread.

DBOps: check replicas: read replicas healthy in eu-west1/us-central. I'll set a lag alert at 2s. If lag spikes >2s for 2m we abort. Also won't run any pg_repack during window.

Ravi S: app compatibility: older clients expect non-normalized usernames; pin api-gateway to 3.7.0 for 45m during canary. If we don't pin, some endpoints reject the new uniqueness semantics.

infra-ops: I'll add a deploy gate to pin service:api-gateway=3.7.0 for 1h and freeze auto-rolls.

QA Bot: preflight checks summary:
```
- conflicting indexes: none
- duplicate samples: 12 duplicates found out of 1.6M active users (samples flagged)
- row lock risk: low (no long txs)
```
Please run full validator before final constraint VALIDATE.

DevLead: rollback criteria (quick):
- abort if validator error rate >1% of batches for 10m
- abort if 500s on user-write endpoints increase by >3pp for 3m
- abort if replica lag >2s for 2m
Fallback: drop NOT VALID constraint (fast) and unpin api-gateway.

June P: validator command (runs on worker fleet):
```
python tools/validate_unique.py --table users --expr "lower(username)" --where "active = true" --batch 10000 --sleep 0.2 --report /tmp/username-validate.json
```
It outputs a summary and a duplicates CSV for remediation.

deploy-bot: preflight hooks passed at 14:55Z. Shadow index create scheduled at 15:00Z. Will post periodic status and canary transition notes.

Ravi S: I'll hold off merging the auth hotfix until constraint is validated. If we see duplication hits, I'll open an incident and revert.

DBOps: SQL we'll run (concurrent safe):
```
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_username_lower_active
ON users (lower(username)) WHERE active = true;
-- after validation:
ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_username_active_unique UNIQUE USING INDEX idx_users_username_lower_active NOT VALID;
ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT users_username_active_unique;
```
Note: last step can be slow depending on duplicates; do not run VALIDATE until validator finishes.

DevLead: metrics to watch: uniqueness-validator success %, write-5xx%, signup latency p95, replica lag. If anything weird, call /hold and escalate.

June P: starting shadow index create at 15:00Z now. Progress updates every 2m.

QA Bot: index create started 15:01Z (pg backend 1824). Current index build ETA ~12m in us-central.

infra-ops: api-gateway pinned to 3.7.0, freeze in effect.

dev-bot: canary: 0.5% -> traffic cut set at 15:10Z.

DBOps: replication lag steady. No long-running locks.

Ravi S: QA please run signup smoke once canary hits 5%. Maria? (tagged)

June P: validator run #1 completed: scanned 200k rows, found 0 new duplicates in that sample, ETA to finish full run ~22m. Report at /artifacts/username-validate-1765129999.json

DevLead: awesome. if validator finishes clean, we proceed to NOT VALID constraint at 15:45Z then validate after 10m of observation.

DBOps: reminder: don't run the final VALIDATE until we confirm no duplicate remediation items remain. VALIDATE will acquire a share lock per-row check and could spike IO.

DevLead: everyone :thumbsup: to proceed?

Ravi S: :thumbsup:

infra-ops: :thumbsup: pinned and monitoring.

QA Bot: full validator finished at 15:27Z, duplicates CSV size 0. No remediation needed.

deploy-bot: adding final step: at 15:40Z run ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT NOT VALID, monitor for 10m, if metrics stable run VALIDATE at 15:50Z.

DevLead: ok proceeding. Post any anomalies here. If rollback needed, plan: DROP CONSTRAINT CONCURRENTLY? (manual) — note PostgreSQL cannot DROP CONSTRAINT CONCURRENTLY; fallback is to DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY and remove constraint entry. Keep communication tight.

DBOps: acknowledged. I will be ready to run drop index concurrently if needed and coordinate app unpin.

-- thread pinned for postmortem --
